info.title: Avocado Connect API
info.description:
Public API for Avocado Connect, Peridio's IoT device management platform.

## Authentication

Programmatic clients authenticate with a personal or org-scoped access token sent as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer avo_...
```

Create a personal access token via `POST /api/me/api-tokens` or an org-scoped token via `POST /api/orgs/{org_id}/api-tokens`. Tokens do not require a CSRF token.

The first-party web app uses an httpOnly session cookie (`cookieAuth`) instead; it is documented for completeness but API consumers should use `bearerAuth`.

## Conventions

- All request and response bodies are JSON.
- Successful resource responses wrap the payload in a top-level `data` field.
- Simple acknowledgements return `{ "ok": true }`.
- Errors return `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<human readable>" }`; validation errors return `{ "errors": { "<field>": ["<message>"] } }` with status 422.
- Resource identifiers are UUID v7 strings unless otherwise noted.
- Org-scoped routes take the organization UUID as the `org_id` path parameter.

tags.name: Authentication & Tokens
tags.description: Obtain and manage API access tokens. Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Create a personal token via `POST /api/me/api-tokens` or an org-scoped token via `POST /api/orgs/{org_id}/api-tokens`.

cookieAuth.description: Session cookie used by the first-party web app (BFF flow). API consumers should use bearerAuth instead.

ValidationError.description: Changeset validation error. Keys are field names; values are lists of messages.

PaginationMeta.description: Cursor pagination metadata. Present only when the request supplied a pagination param (`cursor`, `limit`, or `direction`); otherwise the full list is returned unpaginated with no `meta`.

after.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass back as `?cursor=`.

before.description: Opaque cursor for the previous page.

OrganizationMembership.description: An organization the current user belongs to, with their role and the org's tier limits.

everyone_enabled.description: When true, all org members have access; otherwise access is granted per-user/group.

RuntimeSummary.description: Runtime as returned by list endpoints (omits `config` and `lockfile`, which can be large).

Runtime.description: Runtime detail (adds `config` and `lockfile`; `artifacts` present on create/complete).

UploadSpec.description: Presigned multipart upload URLs for a runtime artifact image.

device_ids.description: Explicit device targeting; null for cohort-wide.

is_targeted.description: True when device_ids or filter_tags is set.

invite_url.description: Present on create only when email delivery is disabled.

tags.description: Tags applied to devices claimed with this token.

token.description: Raw claim token — returned only on create.
Raw Bearer token — returned only on create.

DeviceTunnelSummary.description: Condensed tunnel view used by org-scoped (device) tunnel endpoints.

CohortTunnelPolicy.description: Cohort tunnel policy: the effective (resolved) policy plus the cohort's own overrides (null fields inherit from the org).

root_version_distribution.description: Map of root version → device count.

root_key.description: Present once a root key exists.

events.description: Event types this endpoint subscribes to.

secret.description: Signing secret — returned only on create.

response_status.description: HTTP status returned by the endpoint.

totals.description: Totals keyed by event type; `_all` is the grand total.
